meta.productVersion: 22.6.x (released 2026-10-21; the current release at the audit date)
meta.versionBasis: Minitab Technical Support Policy Annex B lists 22.6.x as the current release; the public help site documents the 22.x product and the Minitab Web App separately.
separateModulesListed: Quality Trainer (not documented in the audited help tree)
meta.urlResolution: Every reference URL below was matched against the sitemap published on 2026-11-24 and then requested over HTTPS; referenceUrlHttpStatus records that request.
meta.scope: All analyses, charts and worksheet/automation commands that the public Help & How-To and Session Command Help trees document for Minitab Statistical Software 22.x, organised into the eight audit domains required by WO-04.
excluded: Minitab Solution Center / Minitab Connect / Model Ops / Engage / Workspace / Simul8 products
Industry add-on modules whose option list is not public (Predictive Analytics internals are counted as one feature each, with UNKNOWN options where only the overview is public)
Quality Trainer courses (not part of the help tree)
limitations: The audit read public documentation only; Minitab was never installed or executed, so no numerical equivalence with Minitab is claimed.
A feature page confirms that a dialog or command exists and lists its published options. Options that only appear in the desktop UI (not in the published page) cannot be enumerated from this source.
The Web App exposes a subset of session commands; the published list of commands unavailable in the web app was not transcribed option by option.
